title: Middle Kingdom temple core
summary: Granite thresholds and a calcite support help identify a largely vanished early temple.
orientation: The open central area behind the later sanctuary.

claims.text: Granite thresholds and a calcite support help identify a largely vanished early temple.
The plan is reconstructed from dispersed remains; scholars differ over its size and orientation. Empty space does not imply an ancient empty courtyard.
